steps.note: 2a: Precrease the upper left quarter line.
2b: Precrease the upper right quarter line.
3: Bring the top edge to the center.
4a: Precrease the upper edge to the nearest horizontal line.
5: Fold the top down on the third horizontal crease.
6a: Fold the top left corner to the nearest corner.
